::: {.research-title}
## <i class="fa-solid fa-flask" aria-hidden="true"></i> Institutions, Incentives, and Democratic Accountability
:::

Reeves’s research examines how executive power and public policy are experienced on the ground. Across projects, he links constitutional design to administrative behavior, geographic targeting, and voter evaluations of government performance.

::: {.research-metrics}
- Presidential power
- Policy delivery
- Political geography
:::
:::

::: {.research-pillars}
::: {.research-pillar}
::: {.pillar-tag}
Executive Authority
:::
### Unilateral Action and Constraint

How emergency powers, institutional checks, and public opinion define the practical limits of presidential action.
:::

::: {.research-pillar}
::: {.pillar-tag}
Geographic Distribution
:::
### Place and Unequal Policy Reach

How partisan incentives and administrative capacity shape where federal resources go, and who benefits.
:::

::: {.research-pillar}
::: {.pillar-tag}
Democratic Evaluation
:::
### Accountability in Practice

How citizens judge government performance when policy design meets local conditions and lived experience.
:::
:::

::: {.research-arc}
### How the Agenda Connects
**Institutions** structure executive choices, **delivery systems** shape who benefits, and **citizen response** drives political accountability.
:::

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const listing = document.querySelector("#listing-listing");
  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".research-view-btn");
  if (!listing || !buttons.length) return;

  const key = "research-list-view";
  const allowed = new Set(["editorial", "compact", "grid"]);

  function applyView(view) {
    const chosen = allowed.has(view) ? view : "editorial";
    listing.classList.remove("view-editorial", "view-compact", "view-grid");
    listing.classList.add("view-" + chosen);

    buttons.forEach((btn) => {
      const active = btn.dataset.view === chosen;
      btn.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
      btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
    });

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, chosen);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  let initial = "editorial";
  const isMobile = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 768px)").matches;
  if (!isMobile) {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (allowed.has(saved)) initial = saved;
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  applyView(initial);
  buttons.forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => applyView(btn.dataset.view));
  });

  const topicButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".research-topic-chip"));
  const topicState = document.querySelector("[data-topic-state]");

  function readTopicFromHash() {
    const raw = window.location.hash ? window.location.hash.slice(1) : "";
    const params = new URLSearchParams(raw);
    return params.get("category") || "";
  }

  function syncTopicChips(topic) {
    topicButtons.forEach((btn) => {
      const active = (btn.dataset.topic || "") === topic;
      btn.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
      btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
    });

    if (topicState) {
      topicState.textContent = topic ? `Filtering by topic: ${topic}.` : "Showing all topics.";
    }
  }

  function applyTopic(topic) {
    if (typeof window.quartoListingCategory !== "function") return;
    const encoded = btoa(encodeURIComponent(topic || ""));
    window.quartoListingCategory(encoded);
    syncTopicChips(topic || "");
  }

  topicButtons.forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => applyTopic(btn.dataset.topic || ""));
  });

  syncTopicChips(readTopicFromHash());
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", () => {
    syncTopicChips(readTopicFromHash());
  });
});
</script>
```
